docs.text: Application Features Adding materials The add_material() method adds a material to the warehouse. Getting material balance The get_balance() method returns the available quantity of a material. Writing off materials The write_off() method decreases the available material quantity. The operation validates that the requested quantity is positive and that sufficient stock is available. Calculating total quantity The get_total_quantity() method calculates the total quantity of all warehouse materials.
